analogy.rationale: EIF2S1 inhibition blocks translation initiation, so other inhibitors of protein synthesis (e.g., mTOR and HSP inhibitors that suppress cap-dependent translation) should yield the most similar transcriptional signatures, while general kinase or proteasome inhibitors share only downstream stress responses.
